landing.pageTitle: Prism - AI Coding Interview Gateway & Evaluation Platform
landing.heroSubtitle: 100% open-source & self-hosted, running seamlessly on your own Cloudflare infrastructure with total data privacy. Built for AI Coding interview evaluation, quota control, and interaction timeline playback.
landing.featuresSubtitle: Simple and practical AI Coding interview evaluation tool
landing.featureWorkersAiDesc: Native support for @cf/ free & cost-effective models with zero configuration.
landing.featureAiGatewayDesc: Seamlessly integration with AI Gateway hosted providers for unified billing.
landing.featureByokDesc: Support for custom/third-party Base URLs and private API Keys.
landing.featureProtocolDesc: Compatible with OpenAI & Anthropic upstream formats and agent clients.
landing.featureQuotaDesc: Quickly set candidate API Key token limits and auto-expiration.
landing.featureTimelineDesc: Accurately record all logs for interviewers to review candidate's prompt timeline.
landing.deploySubtitle: Start evaluating candidates' AI coding skills in just a few clicks
